description: Plan dinners for a week with Bryti's planner, inside the household's rules, events, allergies and pantry. The run is queued and takes one to three minutes; the answer carries a jobId — ask get_planning_status for it. A week that already has planned dinners answers confirmation_required: ask the member, then call again with replace: true. Uses the household's monthly credits, like planning in the app. For the rest of a week that is already planned, use replan_open_days.

allowGeneration.description: How many dinners Bryti may invent this week (0-7). Only when the user says so — «bare to nye retter», «ingen nye retter denne uka». Omit to use the household's own setting.

allowNearMisses.description: Whether a day may bend a soft rule or the calendar's guessed busy-evening cap rather than stay without a dinner. Defaults to true; pass false when the user insists every rule holds even if a day ends up empty.

replace.description: True when the member has said yes to replacing the dinners already planned this week.

weekStart.description: Any date in the week to plan; normalized to that week's Monday.

name: plan_week
title: Plan the week
